meta.name: auth-implementation-patterns
meta.description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为应用加上登录认证和权限校验,防止未授权访问
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发应用并需要实现用户登录和权限管理
copy.tagline_en: Add login and permission checks to your app to block unauthorized access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app and need to add user login and permission management

howto.what: 当你做登录、权限或接口安全相关的工作时,Claude 会按 JWT、OAuth2、会话管理、RBAC 等模式给出实现思路,并指出明文存密码、令牌不过期这类常见坑。
howto.when: 当你在实现认证系统、给 API 加访问保护,或排查安全问题时接管。

say.text: 帮我用 JWT 实现用户登录,访问令牌设 15 分钟过期。
say.note: 会给出令牌签发与刷新流程。

say.text: 给这个 REST API 加上基于角色的权限校验。
say.note: 会按 RBAC 模式给出校验逻辑。

say.text: 用户登录后老是被登出,帮我排查会话管理问题。
say.note: 会从 cookie 与会话配置查起。

howto.what_en: Claude applies JWT, OAuth2, session and RBAC patterns when you build login, permission or API security work, and flags pitfalls like plain-text passwords and non-expiring tokens.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you implement authentication systems, secure an API, or debug security issues.

say_en.text: Help me add JWT login with 15-minute access tokens.
Add role-based permission checks to this REST API.
Users keep getting logged out; help me debug sessions.
say_en.note: Starts with cookie and session config.
